title: First visit defaults to the This Month preset and the user's active location
custom_preconds: 1. You are using a browser with NO saved settings for this report (fresh profile or cleared site storage).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Technician Utilization report.
2. Read the date-range picker value and the location filter value.
custom_expected:
1. The date range defaults to the current calendar month (the date picker's "This Month" preset).
2. Because a range never extends past now, the current-month default effectively shows the month to date.
3. The location filter defaults to the user's currently active location (the one in the application's global location switcher).
